topic: Asking HR for an Employment Letter for an Apartment

script.title: THE EMPLOYMENT LETTER
script.scene_zh: 人資辦公室 · 申請證明
script.story_hook: A short letter can open a brand new door.
script.intro_zh: 一封短短的信，就能替你打開一扇新的門。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's HR office visit. Listen for polite request phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的人資辦公室場景。留意禮貌提出請求的說法。
script.outro: And that's an employment letter on its way. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一封在職證明就這樣安排好了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with chin-length wavy chestnut hair, small gold hoop earrings, a dusty rose blouse, a slim tote bag, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with closely cropped salt and pepper hair, rectangular glasses, a charcoal vest over a white shirt, an office lanyard, and a broad sturdy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Marcus, do you have a quick second?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈmɑɹkəs du ju hæv ə kwɪk ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，Marcus，你現在有空一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's up, is everything okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌts ʌp ɪz ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˌoʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，怎麼了，一切都還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, mostly, I just need a favor actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ ˈmoʊstli aɪ dʒʌst nid ə ˈfeɪvɚ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大致還好，其實想請你幫個忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I'll help if I can.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs aɪl hɛlp ɪf aɪ kæn/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，能幫的我一定幫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, I'm renting an apartment across town.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪm ˈɹɛntɪŋ ən əˈpɑɹtmənt əˈkɹɑs taʊn/
dialogue.zh: 是這樣的，我在城那邊租了一間公寓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, exciting, congrats, when do you move?
dialogue.phonetic: /uː ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ kənˈɡɹæts wɛn du ju muv/
dialogue.zh: 噢，好棒，恭喜你，什麼時候搬？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month, but they need paperwork first.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mʌnθ bʌt ðeɪ nid ˈpeɪpɚwɝk fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 下個月，不過對方要我先備齊文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, you want an employment letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ju wɑnt ən ɪmˈplɔɪmənt ˈlɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 了解，你需要一張在職證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Exactly, is that something you do?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪɡˈzæktli ɪz ðæt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ju du/
dialogue.zh: 對！就是這個，這是你們會開的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, I write them pretty often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz aɪ ɹaɪt ðəm ˈpɹɪti ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 是的，我常常幫人寫這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What all does the letter need to say?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɔl dʌz ðə ˈlɛɾɚ nid tə seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這封信裡需要寫些什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually your title, start date, and status.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli jɔɹ ˈtaɪtəl stɑɹt deɪt ænd ˈstætəs/
dialogue.zh: 通常會寫職稱、到職日期和現任狀態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Status, you mean that I'm still hired?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstætəs ju min ðæt aɪm stɪl ˈhaɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 狀態，你的意思是我現在還在職？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, full time, not on a trial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt fʊl taɪm nɑt ɑn ə ˈtɹaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，全職，而且不是試用期間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and do they want my salary?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ænd du ðeɪ wɑnt maɪ ˈsæləɹi/
dialogue.zh: 好，那他們會要求寫進薪資嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That depends, does the landlord need it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt dɪˈpɛndz dʌz ðə ˈlændˌlɔɹd nid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那要看情況，房東需要這一欄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, the landlord wants the number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ ðə ˈlændˌlɔɹd wɑnts ðə ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，房東就是要那個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I should include it, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ʃʊd ɪnˈklud ɪt ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那我應該把它寫進去，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, um, is it your gross or net?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ʌm ɪz ɪt jɔɹ ɡɹoʊs ɔɹ nɛt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，嗯，要寫稅前還是稅後？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually gross, the yearly total before tax.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli ɡɹoʊs ðə ˈjɪɹli ˈtoʊɾəl bɪˈfɔɹ tæks/
dialogue.zh: 通常是稅前，一年的總額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That number feels a little too public.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈnʌmbɚ filz ə ˈlɪɾɚ tu ˈpʌblɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那個數字感覺有點太公開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get it, some folks ask to hide it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt səm foʊks æsk tə haɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，有些人會要求別寫出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the form literally says income needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə fɔɹm ˈlɪɾɚəli sɛz ˈɪnˌkʌm ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，表單上真的寫著要附收入。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can't skip it, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kænt skɪp ɪt ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就跳不過去了，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, it's for a good reason.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ɪts fɚ ə ɡʊd ˈɹizən/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，這是有正當理由的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, it just proves you can pay rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt dʒʌst pɹuvz ju kæn peɪ ɹɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，它只是證明你付得起租金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense. Should I give you the form?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns ʃʊd aɪ ɡɪv ju ðə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。我要把表單拿給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring it, it lists what to include.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bɹɪŋ ɪt ɪt lɪsts wʌt tə ɪnˈklud/
dialogue.zh: 要的，帶來吧，上面會列該寫哪些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And does it have to be on letterhead?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd dʌz ɪt hæv tə bi ɑn ˈlɛɾɚhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 還有，一定要印在公司信頭上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It must, they won't trust plain paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt mʌst ðeɪ woʊnt tɹʌst pleɪn ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一定要的，他們不會相信白紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, so no just printing from my laptop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ soʊ noʊ dʒʌst ˈpɹɪntɪŋ fɹʌm maɪ ˈlæptɑp/
dialogue.zh: 噢，所以不能直接用筆電列印？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, I print it on the official one.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp aɪ pɹɪnt ɪt ɑn ði əˈfɪʃəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不行，我會用正式信紙替你印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. How long until it's ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt haʊ lɔŋ ʌnˈtɪl ɪts ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。大概多久會好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three business days, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θɹi ˈbɪznəz deɪz noʊ ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 大約三個工作日，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days, hmm, my move is close.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi deɪz həm maɪ muv ɪz kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 三天，嗯，我搬家的日子快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need it sooner than that?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid ɪt ˈsuːnɚ ðæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你需要比那更早拿到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, could I get it by Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ɪt baɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那個，我能在週五之前拿到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday is tight, but I can try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ɪz taɪt bʌt aɪ kæn tɹaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週五有點趕，不過我可以試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? You'd be a total lifesaver.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli jud bi ə ˈtoʊɾəl ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那你就幫了我大忙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll try, no grand promises.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl tɹaɪ noʊ ɡɹænd ˈpɹɑməsəz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我會盡力，不敢保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair, I'd still thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛɹ aɪd stɪl θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 這樣就很好了，我還是會感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool. Want me to email a draft first?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul wɑnt mi tə ˈimeɪl ə dɹæft fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 好。要先用郵件傳一版草稿給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, yes, let me see it before printing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ jɛs lɛt mi si ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ˈpɹɪntɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，好，印之前讓我先看過一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, that way you can check the pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ðæt weɪ ju kæn tʃɛk ðə peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣你就能先確認薪資金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And can I ask to change the wording?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kæn aɪ æsk tə tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈwɝdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，我可以請你把措辭改一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, small tweaks are no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ smɔl twiks ɑɹ noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 當然，小地方的調整沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like, maybe salary instead of income?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈmeɪbi ˈsæləɹi ɪnˈstɛd ʌv ˈɪnˌkʌm/
dialogue.zh: 比如說，把收入換成薪資這樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, that word choice is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ ðæt wɝd tʃɔɪs ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，這種用詞完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Should I sign anything for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ʃʊd aɪ saɪn ˈɛniˌθɪŋ fɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我需要為這個簽什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one request form, I'll grab it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn ɹɪˈkwɛst fɔɹm aɪl ɡɹæb ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只要一張申請表就好，我拿給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and do I pick up the final copy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ænd du aɪ pɪk ʌp ðə ˈfaɪnəl ˈkɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 好，那最後的紙本要我自己來取嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can email the PDF or print two.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈimeɪl ðə ˌpi di ˈef ɔɹ pɹɪnt tu/
dialogue.zh: 我可以傳 PDF 給你，或是列印兩份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two printed, um, one for the landlord?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpɹɪntɪd ʌm wʌn fɚ ðə ˈlændˌlɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 列印兩份，嗯，一份給房東？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, and one for your own file.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ænd wʌn fɚ jɔɹ ˈoʊn faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 對，另一份留給你自己存檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's thoughtful, I hadn't even thought of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈθɔtfl aɪ ˈhædən ˈivən θɔt ʌv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 真貼心，我根本沒想到這一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happens, moving is a lot at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpənz ˈmuvɪŋ ɪz ə lɑt ɑt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 難免啦，搬家本來就事情多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about it, thanks for your help.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt θæŋks fɔɹ jɔɹ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 就是說啊，謝謝你願意幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. I'll get that draft out today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm aɪl ɡɛt ðæt dɹæft aʊt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，我今天就把草稿傳出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're the best, I owe you a coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ðə bɛst aɪ oʊ ju ə ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 你真是大好人，我欠你一杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, noted, I'll hold you to that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊtɪd aɪl hoʊld ju tə ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，記下了，那我可就等著囉。

script.youtube_title: 【租屋要附在職證明📄】「房東就是要那個數字」💰教你用英文請人資開薪水證明💼｜聽完就能自己開口｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Employment Letter for Apartment
script.youtube_title_en: "The Landlord Wants the Number" — Asking HR for an Employment Letter
script.youtube_description:
「房東就是要那個數字」——租新房要附一張在職證明，怎麼用英文請人資幫你開，還把薪資寫得剛剛好？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在員工走進人資辦公室的那次懇談。

你會聽到：禮貌開場、說明租屋需求、確認信裡要寫職稱到職日期與現任狀態；要寫稅前還是稅後、能不能不寫薪水的來回討論；還有公司信頭、三個工作日、先傳草稿給你過目，以及最後決定列印兩份的實用說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦公室對話的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、ooh、cool。聽完你就會用：do you have a quick second?、Should I...、does it have to be...、I'll get that draft out today。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The landlord wants the number" — your new apartment needs an employment letter, so how do you ask HR for one and get the pay line right? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in the HR office.

You will hear: a polite opening, explaining the rental need, and confirming the letter should list your title, start date and full time status; the back and forth about gross versus net pay and whether salary has to show; plus company letterhead, three business days, emailing a draft to check first, and finally printing two copies.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the office texture Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, ooh, cool. By the end you'll own phrases like do you have a quick second?, does it have to be..., and I'll get that draft out today.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧申請在職證明英文・職稱到職日與稅前薪資・公司信頭與三個工作日｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看中一間新公寓，房東卻要你先附上一張在職證明，薪資那一欄到底要不要寫、該怎麼寫？要等三天來得及嗎？

這一集帶大家陪一位員工走進人資辦公室，從禮貌開口、確認信件內容、討論稅前薪資與公司信頭，一路聽到先傳草稿、列印兩份與取件方式，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📄 開場句：Hi Marcus, do you have a quick second?
💰 薪資討論：Great, um, is it your gross or net?
🏢 信頭句：Oh, so no just printing from my laptop?
📎 時間確認：About three business days, no rush.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、ooh、cool 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這次人資懇談走一遍，下次自己要證明文件，就能清楚又禮貌地開口。

祝你新公寓的申請一路順利。
script.thumbnail_action: handing a rental paperwork form across a desk
